At home, Górnik have won four, drawn two and lost one of their seven league matches. That is a solid return at Arena Zabrze, even if it leaves room for improvement. Their 23 league goals indicate a productive attack, while 14 conceded suggests a defence that has generally kept opponents in check. Against a Wisła side with a negative goal difference, Górnik will likely try to take control early and use their home advantage to create pressure.

## Wisła Płock’s current form and challenges [...] Górnik’s position near the top of the table, their stronger goal difference and their more reliable recent form all point towards a home victory. Their record at Arena Zabrze is not flawless, but four wins from seven league games is a solid platform. Wisła’s away defeats and recent run of three losses in five make the visitors the less convincing side on the available evidence. [...] There are reasons not to treat the result as certain: Górnik are coming off a defeat, and the head-to-head series has included two draws in its last five matches. Still, the overall balance of form and league performance gives the hosts a clear edge. Our principal prediction is Górnik Zabrze to win, with both teams to score as a secondary option for those expecting Wisła to find a way through.
